faq.q: What is the origin of Emil?
faq.a: Emil is associated with Latin. Emil is a European male given name, from Latin Aemilius. It is used among Muslims in the Caucasus and Central Asia.
No — the underlying form is Latin, not Arabic.
Emil can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Latin-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
